resources.string: Search stations, e.g. Radio Mirchi, BBC
Tap the heart on a station to keep it here.
Station list from radio-browser.info. Streams come straight from each broadcaster.
Play music from a PC, laptop or NAS on your Wi-Fi without copying it
Your PC\'s music, on your phone
Works with Windows and Mac file sharing, Samba and NAS drives such as Synology or WD. Phone and computer must be on the same Wi-Fi.
On Windows: right-click your music folder, then Properties, Sharing, Share. Then tap Add network folder and type the address shown there, such as \\\\192.168.1.5\\Music.
Leave the username empty for folders shared with everyone. The password stays on this phone.
Type the computer and the shared folder, for example \\\\192.168.1.5\\Music
Bit-perfect: the DAC gets the file untouched
Keeps 24-bit and 32-bit files at full depth. While on, speed, pitch and the visualiser pause for those files.
Applies after you close Ampli and open it again.
With a USB DAC plugged in, sends the file\'s own sample rate to the DAC without Android resampling it. Use the DAC\'s volume.
